title: Expose scoped Center and Scheduling registry facts
verify: The Center & Scheduling query returns authorized account IDs plus its own institution, class, membership, parent-link, assignment, and count facts for Students, Teachers, and Classes.
Admin receives own-center facts, Teacher receives assigned-class facts, and Student/Parent center-wide requests are denied without unrelated row disclosure.
The query is read-only and neither calls Identity & Access nor returns profile fields, attendance percentages, payment capability, or a composed registry payload.
evidence_required: statistics-projection.md#center-and-scheduling-registry-facts-query / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: the query broadens scope, omits required C&S facts, calls Identity & Access, returns profile/metric fields, or mutates state; GREEN: isolated provider tests prove own-center/assigned-class facts, Student/Parent and removed-assignment denial, no neighbor call, and state-before/state-after equality; artifact: .tasks/TASK-073-T3-FT-007-W30/ and .protocols/TASK-073-T3-FT-007-W30/.
purpose: Expose the scoped Center & Scheduling structural input needed by the Lesson Context statistics composition.
success_outcome: One public Center & Scheduling query returns only authorized owner-held registry facts and account IDs without crossing into profile or metric ownership.
anti_goals: Do not claim or prove FT-007-AC-003 as a complete registry result.
Do not call Identity & Access or return fullName/registeredAt.
Do not compute attendance, payment capability, sorting, or route composition.
constraints: Center & Scheduling owns only registry scope and center/class/membership/assignment facts.
Lesson Context performs all profile enrichment and final registry composition.
Tests use isolated disposable state and do not touch study-calendar.db.
invariants: Admin scope is own Center and Teacher scope is assigned classes.
Student/Parent cannot obtain center-wide registry facts.
No query writes source facts, calls a neighbor, or broadens scope from client input.
verification_targets: statistics-projection.md#center-and-scheduling-registry-facts-query: exact field ownership, role/scope matrix, neighbor-call absence, and non-mutation.
boundary-map.md#calendar-and-membership-query-boundary: Center & Scheduling remains the sole owner of registry structural facts.

stop_conditions: Stop if registry facts require a new source-of-truth owner or public edge.
Stop if C&S would need profile fields, a neighbor call, direct neighbor-table access, or client scope authority.
